hero.subtitle: Invitation-only immersive experiences for a maximum of six participants

ethos.body1: ShamanicTravels is a private, selection-based journey across the high Andes and Amazonian basins. We do not provide group tours. We curate deep experiential thresholds for those ready to encounter Peru's living wisdom traditions.
ethos.body2: Combining the logistical precision of luxury travel with the profound silence of Peru's sacred geography, every element is managed with calm authority and absolute privacy.

journeys.meta: Each journey · 21 days · Maximum six participants · Selection required
journeys.j1_desc: A cultural and geographic expedition from the Pacific coast through the high Andes — Paracas, Nazca, Arequipa, Titicaca, Palcoyo, Machu Picchu and Cusco — with ritual integration embedded along the route.
journeys.j2_desc: A structured field-based immersion deep in the Peruvian Amazon forest. River transfer from Pucallpa into remote basin territory, alternating cycles of guided traditional practice and integration.

guide.title: Marcello Buglione
guide.body1: With a foundation in strategic communication, NLP and hypnosis, and decades of international training, Marcello is more than a guide. He is the architect of the experience.
guide.body2: His evolution into immersive Peruvian journeys distils complex cultural wisdom into precise, transformative travel paths for executives, entrepreneurs and professionals operating at high altitudes of life.
guide.quote: We do not design entertainment. We design attention, presence, and experience.

apply.title: How to Join
apply.desc: These are private journeys. Each participant is carefully selected through a personal interview to ensure alignment with our values and mutual readiness. We turn away more people than we accept.
apply.s1_desc: Submit your interest. Tell us what calls you and what you hope to find.
apply.s2_desc: We speak with you privately to understand your intentions and assess readiness. This is not transactional.
apply.s3_desc: If selected, you receive detailed guidance on physical, practical, and contemplative preparation for your journey.
apply.note: Journeys depart quarterly. Next departure: Q3 2026.

testimonials.title: What They Carry Forward
testimonials.q1: In the silence of the mountains, I found myself.
testimonials.q2: Not what I expected. Far deeper. A threshold I didn't know I needed to cross.
testimonials.q3: Marcello doesn't teach. He witnesses. And somehow, that witnessing changes everything.

amazon.meta_title: Amazon Retreat in San Alejandro — A Calling, Not a Vacation · ShamanicTravels
amazon.meta_desc: A 22-day Amazonian retreat in San Alejandro with Maestro Carlos "Chichi" Escudero. For those undergoing profound life transformation and ready for serious commitment. Applications open for November 2026.
amazon.og_title: Amazon Retreat in San Alejandro — A Calling, Not a Vacation
amazon.og_desc: 22 days in the heart of the Peruvian Amazon with Maestro Carlos "Chichi" Escudero. This path is not for everyone. Applications open for November 2026.
amazon.hero_title: There comes a point in life where understanding is no longer enough. You must cross.
amazon.hero_desc: A 22-day Amazonian retreat in San Alejandro, guided by Maestro Carlos “Chichi” Escudero. It is not a vacation. It is not a cure. It is a serious commitment, with equally serious preparation, for those who feel that something in their life needs to change deeply.
amazon.premise_lead: Twenty-two days. A single, profound, continuous Amazonian immersion in San Alejandro.
amazon.premise_body_p1: Hosted in San Alejandro, in the heart of the Peruvian Amazon, this retreat offers participants the opportunity to work with traditional master plants in a context deeply connected to the living traditions of Amazonian medicine. From Pucallpa, we move by river to the San Alejandro region, where a selected lodge and village setting become the base for a continuous Master Plant Dieta guided by Maestro Carlos “Chichi” Escudero.
amazon.premise_body_p2: Arrival in Pucallpa is scheduled for November 1, 2026. The retreat program runs from November 3 to 24, 2026, with departure on November 25, 2026. Selection is rigorous. Preparation is mandatory. The retreat is not available without both.
amazon.why_title: Why I return to San Alejandro.
amazon.why_subtitle:
There are places you visit.
And places that become part of your life.
amazon.why_body_p1: I met Maestro Carlos “Chichi” Escudero almost ten years ago. Since then, I have brought people here from all over the world, returning several times a year to work with him and with the living traditions of the Amazon forest.
amazon.why_body_p2: Over the years, San Alejandro has become much more than a destination. It has become a place I know intimately: the river, the forest, the trails, the local communities, the plants, the silences, and the rhythms that mark daily life.
amazon.why_body_p3: I have lived some of the most significant moments of my life here.
amazon.why_body_p4: I remember the long boat journeys along the river. The days spent in the forest searching for plants. The conversations around the fire. The shared laughter during meals. The sunset fishing. The friendships born among people arriving from different continents, united by the same inner search.
amazon.why_body_p5: For many years, I called San Alejandro my centre of transformation.
amazon.why_body_p7: But because here I witnessed something that is increasingly hard to find today: authenticity, humanity, and a genuine relationship with the medicine of the forest.
amazon.why_body_p8: After a long period away from the Amazon, I chose to return exactly here.
amazon.why_body_p9: Not because it is the most famous place.
amazon.why_body_p10: Not because it is the most luxurious.
amazon.why_body_p11: And not even because it is the easiest to reach.
amazon.why_body_p12: I return because I know the people. I know the place. I know the work that is done.
amazon.why_body_p13: And above all because, when I accompany someone on such an important journey, I want to be able to say sincerely:
amazon.c1_desc: November 1, 2026. Decompression in a selected hotel in Pucallpa. Briefing, medical checks, equipment review.
amazon.c2_desc: Private boat transfer from Pucallpa to San Alejandro, in the Peruvian Amazon. The journey itself is part of the immersion.
amazon.c3_desc: Remote lodge and village context in San Alejandro. The rhythm of life slows down. Daylight, river, fire.
amazon.c4_desc: November 3-24, 2026. Structured cycles of guided traditional practice with Maestro Chichi, alternating with full days of integration.
amazon.c5_desc: Return journey on the river, integration day in Pucallpa, departure on November 25, 2026.
amazon.maloca_title: The Maloca: the heart of the journey
amazon.maloca_desc: Here the ceremonies come to life. The maloca is the temple of our transformation, where the circle closes and healing begins.
amazon.prep_ess_subtitle: The difference isn't made by the twenty-two days...
amazon.prep_ess_body_p1: ...it's made by everything that precedes them.
amazon.prep_ess_body_p2: The Master Plant Dieta does not begin on the day of arrival in Pucallpa. It begins three months earlier, the moment a participant agrees to abstain from alcohol and substances, to discipline their diet, and to slow down the mental and emotional rhythms that daily life imposes.
amazon.prep_ess_body_p3: This is not an organisational detail. It is the very condition that makes working with the plants safe, profound, and truly transformative.
amazon.prep_ess_body_p4: An unprepared body and mind meet the medicine of the forest on the surface. A prepared body and mind, however, can receive it fully: in the clarity needed to navigate the ceremonies, in the stability required to hold what emerges, and in the capacity to genuinely integrate the experience.
amazon.prep_ess_body_p5: This is why selection is rigorous and preparation is mandatory. Not to make the path more difficult, but to protect its value. The master plants work with those who arrive ready to receive them.
amazon.prep_ess_closing: The quality of your preparation will determine the depth of your experience.
amazon.plants_desc: At the heart of this Amazonian retreat is the Master Plant Dieta, a traditional Amazonian practice where participants work individually with specific plants under the guidance of Maestro Chichi. Each plant brings its own traditional focus within Amazonian plant medicine.
amazon.plant_1_focus: Protection, grounding, and connection with the forest.
amazon.plant_2_focus: Emotional opening, compassion, and heart-centred work.
amazon.plants_note: The specific plants used during the retreat may vary based on Maestro Chichi's guidance and the individual needs of the participants.
amazon.location_desc_p1: Hosted in San Alejandro, in the heart of the Peruvian Amazon, this immersive retreat offers participants the opportunity to work with traditional master plants in a context deeply connected to the living traditions of Amazonian medicine.
amazon.location_desc_p2: Reached by private river transfer from Pucallpa, San Alejandro provides the remote and undisturbed environment required by a traditional Master Plant Dieta: a place shaped by the forest, the river, and decades of practice with Amazonian plants.
amazon.location_quote_p1: For many years, I called San Alejandro my centre of transformation.
amazon.location_quote_p2: Here I have seen people change.
amazon.location_quote_p3: Here I have built friendships that last to this day.
amazon.location_quote_p4: Here I learned that the medicine of the forest is not just about the plants, but also the human relationships that grow around them.
amazon.maestro_desc_p1: This Amazonian retreat is held in collaboration with Maestro Carlos “Chichi” Escudero, a traditional Amazonian healer and practitioner of master plants with decades of experience within the living traditions of the Peruvian Amazon.
amazon.maestro_desc_p2: Raised in the Amazon forest, Maestro Chichi's relationship with master plants spans a lifetime of direct, ancestral knowledge passed down through generations of practitioners in the region. His work is rooted in a profound and continuous connection with the forest itself: its plants, its rhythms, and the traditional practices surrounding them.
amazon.maestro_desc_p3: Throughout the retreat, Maestro Chichi guides every cycle of the Master Plant Dieta, drawing on this extensive experience to keep traditional practices at the centre of the program.
amazon.maestro_desc_p4: I have known Chichi for almost ten years. Over this period, I have accompanied people here from all over the world and had the privilege of working directly with him in hundreds of ceremonies. He is one of the few people to whom I would unhesitatingly entrust someone I love.
amazon.inc_desc: Everything below is included from your arrival in Pucallpa on November 1, 2026, until your departure on November 25, 2026. International flights are not included.
amazon.inc_yes_1: Accommodation in the selected hotel in Pucallpa and at the base camp in San Alejandro
amazon.inc_yes_2: Meals according to retreat and dietary guidelines
amazon.inc_yes_3: All ceremonies and guided plant practices with Maestro Chichi
amazon.inc_yes_4: The complete Master Plant Dieta program
amazon.inc_yes_5: Local transport related to the retreat, including river transfers between Pucallpa and San Alejandro
amazon.inc_yes_6: Guidance and support throughout the retreat, from arrival to departure
amazon.inc_no_1: International flights to and from Peru
amazon.inc_no_2: Domestic flights between Lima and Pucallpa
amazon.prep_title: Preparation is the foundation of your journey's success.
amazon.prep_desc: A three-month preparation protocol precedes the retreat. It exists for safety, focus, and to make integration possible. Without this protocol, the retreat is not offered.
amazon.prep_v1: None for the entire three months prior.
amazon.prep_v2: None for the entire three months prior.
amazon.prep_v3: Disciplined eating: comprehensive guidelines provided upon selection.
amazon.prep_v4: Daily preparation practice, journaling, reduction of stimuli.
amazon.prep_v5: Recommended for at least three weeks prior to departure.
amazon.prep_v6: Mandatory 1:1 session with Marcello before departure.
amazon.footer_title: Receive “I Luoghi Sacri degli Inca” for free
amazon.footer_desc: A compendium written by the founder — the result of years of travel. A pre-tour guide packed with essential information.
amazon.hero_img_alt: Canopy of the Amazon forest in San Alejandro, Peruvian Amazon
amazon.qualify_intro: The people who arrive in San Alejandro are often going through a phase of deep transformation: a crisis, a loss, a burnout, a question they can no longer put off. They are people willing to commit seriously, open to learning and discipline, who feel an authentic calling toward this path — not mere curiosity.
amazon.qualify_no_label: This path may not be right for you if
amazon.qualify_no1: You are looking for a quick fix to your problems.
amazon.qualify_no3: You are not willing to follow a three-month preparation protocol.
amazon.qualify_no4: You are looking for a spiritual vacation.
amazon.qualify_no5: You are not willing to question deeply held beliefs about yourself.
amazon.qualify_no6: You do not have genuine availability for the preparatory work before the retreat.
amazon.qualify_yes_label: This path may be for you if
amazon.qualify_yes1: You are going through a major life transformation.
amazon.qualify_yes2: You are willing to commit seriously to the process, from start to finish.
amazon.qualify_yes3: You are open to the learning and discipline that the Dieta requires.
amazon.qualify_yes4: You feel an authentic calling toward this path, not just curiosity.
amazon.qualify_clarity: We do not write this to discourage you, but for clarity. A sincere application, even if it leads to a “not now,” is worth more than a sign-up made for the wrong reasons.
amazon.who_title: There is no single reason to come.
amazon.who_subtitle: But there is almost always a turning point.
amazon.who1_title: A crisis that can no longer be postponed
amazon.who1_desc: A marriage ended, a diagnosis, a loss, a question about who you have become. Something that has broken the autopilot and demands a real answer.
amazon.who2_title: A burnout after years of performance
amazon.who2_desc: Executives, entrepreneurs, professionals who have built much externally and feel they have lost touch with something essential within themselves.
amazon.who3_desc: A phase change — turning fifty, a divorce, children leaving, a career ending — that asks to be crossed, not just managed.
amazon.who4_desc: Not superficial curiosity, but a question you have carried inside for years and that, at some point, demands a concrete step.
amazon.maloca_img_alt: Interior of the ceremonial maloca in San Alejandro, circle of participants during a ceremony
amazon.plants_honesty: It must be said clearly: working with master plants, and especially with Ayahuasca, can bring moments of real emotional discomfort during the ceremonies — fear, pain, direct confrontation with what you have avoided for years. This is not a side effect to hide. It is part of the process, and it is one of the reasons why the preparation and accompaniment of Maestro Chichi are non-negotiable conditions.
